title: Study Skills
subject: Learning skills
description: Make room for your next big idea. Build better habits for taking notes, finding focus, and making what you learn stick.

title: World History
subject: History
description: Follow the connections between people, places, and ideas, from early farming communities to our global world.

title: Biology
subject: Science
description: Explore the living world, from tiny cells to whole ecosystems. Discover how life works, changes, and connects us all.

title: Astronomy
subject: Science
description: Look up, then look closer. Explore planets, stars, galaxies, and the questions that help us understand our place in the universe.

title: Philosophy
subject: Humanities
description: Make room for big questions about knowledge, reality, and how to live. Practice following an argument and looking at an idea from another angle.

title: Computer Science
subject: Technology
description: Find out what happens beneath the screen. Follow the ideas behind computers, from logic gates and programs to networks and the web.
